>
> Most of the commands below can be run from the “Run Box” with the shortcuts
> `WIN+R` or `WIN+E CTRL+L`.
>
> To run the commands with admin privileges, hit `Ctrl+Shift+Enter` after typing them.
>
> See also the keyboard shortcuts:
> <https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accessibility/windows/keyboard-shortcuts-in-windows>
> <https://support.microsoft.com/fr-fr/accessibility/windows/keyboard-shortcuts-in-windows>

## TERMINALS

> ⚠️ Use ✅ PowerShell (v7) not 🚫 Windows PowerShell (v5). They are different applications.
> <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/scripting/whats-new/differences-from-windows-powershell>


| Command          | Name                                                                                     |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pwsh`           | ✅ PowerShell (7.6.5)                                                                    |
| `wt`             | 🚫 Windows PowerShell (5.1.26100.8457)                                                   |
| `powershell`     | 🚫 Windows PowerShell (5.1.26100.8457)                                                   |
| `powershell_ise` | 🚫 Windows PowerShell (5.1.26100.8457)                                                   |
| `cmd`            | COMMAND.COM, cmd.exe, Command Prompt, Windows Command Processor, Command Processor Shell |

## BASIC COMMANDS

**GET WINDOWS VERSION**
:   ```powershell
    winver
    ```

**GET SYSTEM INFORMATION**
:   ```powershell
    msinfo32
    ```

**SHUTDOWN / RESTART COMPUTER**
:   <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/shutdown>
:   ```powershell
    shutdown /p
    shutdown /r
    ```

**OPEN DEVICE MANAGER**
:   ```powershell
    devmgmt.msc
    ```

**OPEN TASK MANAGER (CTRL+SHIFT+ESC)**
:   ```powershell
    taskmgr
    ```

**GET TERMINAL VERSION**
:   ```powershell
    Get-Process -Id $PID | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Path; $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()
    ```

**SET “WINDOWS TERMINAL” AS DEFAULT**
:   IN SYSTEM/ADVANCED
:   (OLD DEFAULT WAS “WINDOWS CONSOLE HOST”)
:   search for terminal in:
:   ```dosbat
    ms-settings:developers
    ```

**KILL A TASK**
:   ```powershell
    taskkill /im filename.exe /t /f
    ```

**OPEN FONT DIRECTORY**
:   ```dosbat
    %WINDIR%/Fonts
    shell:fonts
    %CSIDL_FONTS%
    ```

**OPEN USER DIRECTORY**
:   ```dosbat
    %HOMEPATH%
    %USERPROFILE%
    ```

**OPEN 64 BIT PROGRAM FILES DIRECTORY (x64)**
:   ```dosbat
    %PROGRAMFILES%
    ```

**OPEN 32 BIT PROGRAM FILES DIRECTORY (x86)**
:   ```dosbat
    %PROGRAMFILES(X86)%
    ```

**OPEN “OPTIONAL FEATURES” WINDOW**
:   ```powershell
    OptionalFeatures.exe
    ```

**OPEN WINDOWS EXPLORER**
:   ```text
    WIN+E
    ```

**SHOW DESKTOP**
:   ```text
    WIN+D
    ```

**SHOW SETTINGS**
:   ```text
    WIN+I
    ```

**LOCK SCREEN**
:   ```text
    WIN+L
    ```

**CHECK FOR UPDATES**
:   ```text
    ms-settings:windowsupdate
    ```

**DISABLE ANNOYING SOUNDS**
: click on 3rd tab “Sounds”
: choose “No Sounds” in dropdown “Sound Schemes”
:   ```powershell
    mmsys.cpl
    ```

**TOGGLE WIFI**
:   ```dosbat
    ncpa.cpl
    ```

## INSTALL

: `--scope machine` requests installation for all users; it does not select an installer format.
: Approve the administrator prompt when required. `--silent` does not suppress this prompt.
: Windows Terminal uses `--scope user`, as required by its MSIX package.
: Wireshark uses the interactive EXE installer so that Npcap can also be installed for packet capture.
: See [WinGet installation options](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/package-manager/winget/install) and [Wireshark installation instructions](https://www.wireshark.org/docs/wsug_html_chunked/ChBuildInstallWinInstall.html).
:   ```powershell
    winget install -e --id Git.Git                                --source winget --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id GitHub.cli                             --source winget --installer-type wix --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id Microsoft.VisualStudioCode             --source winget --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id Hugo.Hugo.Extended                     --source winget --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id PedroAlbanese.QREncode                 --source winget --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;

    git config --global user.name "NicHub on Windows";
    git config --global user.email "nicolas.jeanmonod@gmail.com";
    git clone https://github.com/ouilogique/enfants-kara.ch.git

    # set pwsh as default
    # Win+R pwsh
    # Ctrl+,
    # Default profile: PowerShell (And not Windows PowerShell)

    winget search Python # liste des versions Python disponibles
    winget install -e --id Microsoft.WindowsTerminal              --source winget --scope user --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id Microsoft.PowerShell                   --source winget --installer-type wix --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id Python.Python.3.14                     --source winget --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS                      --source winget --installer-type wix --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id Brave.Brave                            --source winget --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id Mozilla.Firefox.DeveloperEdition       --source winget --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id BurntSushi.ripgrep.MSVC                --source winget --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id sharkdp.fd                             --source winget --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id Neovim.Neovim                          --source winget --installer-type wix --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id PuTTY.PuTTY                            --source winget --installer-type wix --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id WiresharkFoundation.Wireshark          --source winget --scope machine --installer-type nullsoft --interactive --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id EclipseFoundation.Mosquitto            --source winget --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id Rclone.Rclone                          --source winget --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    winget install -e --id WinSCP.WinSCP                          --source winget --installer-type wix --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    # FileZilla Client is unavailable in the winget source. Download: https://filezilla-project.org/download.php?type=client
    # New installation: run from PowerShell as administrator.
    winget install -e --id Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools `
        --source winget `
        --scope machine `
        --silent `
        --accept-package-agreements `
        --accept-source-agreements `
        --override "--quiet --wait --norestart --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Workload.VCTools --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.ARM64 --includeRecommended"
    npm install -g @openai/codex
    ```

**Upgrade all**
:   ```powershell
    winget upgrade --all
    ```

**Upgrade single**
:   ```powershell
    winget upgrade --id Microsoft.VisualStudioCode --installer-type inno --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
    winget upgrade --id Microsoft.PowerShell --installer-type wix --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
    ```

**OpenCode sans WSL (déconseillé)**
:   ```powershell
    npm config set allow-scripts=opencode-ai --location=user
    npm install -g opencode-ai
    ```

## WSL — Windows Subsystem for Linux

**Requirements**
: Vérifier que la virtualisation est activée dans le BIOS.
: Dans le BIOS, l’option s’appelle par ex. sur HP : `System Configuration/Virtualization Technology`.
: Vérifier dans PowerShell :
:   ```powershell
    systeminfo | findstr /i "Virtualization"
    ```

**Install WSL**
:   ```powershell
    wsl --install
    shutdown /r
    wsl -l -v
    wsl --install Ubuntu-26.04
    ```

**Usefull WSL commands**
:   ```powershell
    wsl                # démarre dans la distro par défaut (Ubuntu)
    wsl -d Ubuntu      # démarre une distro précise
    wsl -l -v          # liste les distros installées + leur version
    wsl --update       # met à jour WSL
    ```

## OTHER

**Change default browser**
:   ```text
    ms-settings:defaultapps
    ```

**Change color theme**
:   ```text
    ms-settings:colors
    ```

**Coreutils: 78 Linux commands for powershell**
: <https://github.com/microsoft/coreutils>
:   ```powershell
    ls "C:\Program Files\coreutils\bin\"
    ```
: <https://youtu.be/Bg8FjRGuW_w?t=356>
:   ```powershell
    winget install -e --id Microsoft.Coreutils                    --source winget --scope machine --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements;
    ```

**Install WSL1**
:   ```powershell
    dism.exe /online /enable-feature /featurename:Microsoft-Windows-Subsystem-Linux /all /norestart
    ```

**Optional**
:   ```powershell
    dism.exe /online /enable-feature /featurename:VirtualMachinePlatform /all /norestart
    ```

**Reboot**
: Télécharger le MSI officiel Microsoft (WSL redistribuable)
:   ```powershell
    curl.exe -L -o "$env:TEMP\wsl_update.msi" "https://aka.ms/wslupdate"
    Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$env:TEMP\wsl_update.msi","/qn" -Wait
    wsl --set-default-version 1
    wsl --install -d Ubuntu
    ```
